summary: Our team Minion Apps developed an interactive and simple game for the Challenge Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer. Our target audience are mostly kids who are interested in learning and understanding the importance of decisions in space and how they have an impact on different aspects in space missions. Our game is focused on a mission of surviving and improving a temporal life in Mars, where the player can complete certain missions related to the problems an astronaut might experience to return back to earth.
details: Our game is called “Moonions in Space”; it is mostly produced on . The benefits of this exact project are the interest in the younger generation, where they are able to understand the type of problematics and real ways to solve those problematics, as well as being able to participate and understand how those type of missions are solved with a little extra and easy help through a videogame. The intended impact of this project is that small minds create a big change; kids can either be interested in becoming an astronaut or learning about space,  these little changes can make that kids become more interested in learning about our planet and space, and with this start participating in competitions or in the future their life plan. The tools that we use to develop this project are programming softwares such as GDevelop, laptops, tablets, graphical tablets and non copyright audios. Our project was created without the help of Super Intelligence, meaning that everything we made was created and thought by us, our project is mostly creative by the way we tried that everything was kid friendly and easy to understand making it interactive enough. Our team considers the factors of lacking power, food production, presence of radiation and lack of oxygen in an unknown planet and how the player is able to face these factors.
